title: ProxyPool
description: Represents a pool of proxy IPs offered by a proxy network, including type, geography, rotation behavior, and authentication.

id.description: Unique identifier of the proxy pool.

name.description: Human-readable name of the proxy pool.

provider.description: Proxy network provider operating the pool.

proxy_type.description: Type of proxies that make up the pool.

rotation.description: How IP addresses are rotated across requests in the pool.

sticky_session_ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of a sticky session in seconds when rotation is sticky or timed.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes available for geo-targeting in the pool.

pool_size.description: Approximate number of unique IPs available in the pool.

endpoint.description: Hostname or URL clients connect to in order to use the pool.

authentication.description: Authentication required to use the pool.

pricing_model.description: How usage of the pool is billed.
